description:
Montbrio-Pazo-Roxin model

The exact macroscopic dynamics of a specific brain region (represented as a node in the network) can be analytically derived in the thermodynamic limit of infinitely all-to-all coupled spiking neurons [Montbrio2015] or `theta` neuron representation [Byrne2020next]. By assuming a Lorentzian distribution on excitabilities in large ensembles of quadratic integrate-and-fire neurons with synaptic weights J and a half-width `delta` centered at `eta`, the macroscopic dynamics has been derived in terms of the collective firing activity and mean membrane potential [Montbrio2015].

[Montbrio2015]Montbrio, E., et al. (2015). Macroscopic description for networks of spiking neurons. Physical Review X, 5(2), 021028.
[Byrne2020next]Byrne, A., et al. (2020). Next generation neural mass models. Journal of Neuroscience Methods, 340, 108746.

arguments.G: Scaling the strength of network connections.
arguments.dt_bold: Integration time step for Baloon model.
arguments.tau: Time constant that sets the time scale of the neural dynamics.
arguments.delta: Spread of the heterogeneous noise distribution.
arguments.same_noise_per_sim: If True, the same noise will be used for all simulations.
arguments.sti_apply: If True, the stimulation will be applied.
arguments.t_cut: Transient period to discard from the beginning of the simulation.
arguments.rv_decimate: Sampling step for r and v.
arguments.RECORD_RV: If True, stores the neural state variables r and v.
arguments.RECORD_BOLD: If True, stores the simulated BOLD signal.
arguments.RECORD_AVG_r: If True, stores the node-averaged firing rate.
arguments.num_sim: Number of simulations to run (batch size).
arguments.method: Numerical integration method. Supported values: 'heun' or 'euler'.
arguments.dtype: Data type to use for the simulation, `float` for `float64` or `f` for `float32`.
arguments.initial_state: Initial state of the system of shape (`num_nodes`, `num_sim`).
arguments.same_initial_state: If True, use the same initial condition for all simulations.
